noPermission.title: Garment labels are not for your role
noPermission.body: Printing garment labels needs the labels permission at this station. Ask your team leader.

scan.title: For which work order?
scan.lead: Scan the traveller or a bundle ticket at the final operation, or a garment’s serial label to print it again.
scan.label: Scan or type the code

camera.error: The camera cannot be used here. Type the code instead.

note.otherLabel: {code} is not a work order, bundle or serial label. Scan the traveller or a bundle ticket.
note.otherFactory: {code} is a label of another factory.
note.typo: {code} was misread. Scan it again or type it.
note.notFound: Nothing at this site has the code {code}.
note.several: Several work orders have the number {code}: scan a bundle ticket of yours instead.
note.reprinted_one: Printed again: {count} label of {what}. The reason is logged.
note.reprinted_other: Printed again: {count} labels of {what}. The reason is logged.

sizes.titleBatch: Which size · labels with the batch number
sizes.titleSerial: Which size · a serial label per garment
sizes.label: Size
sizes.overLabelled_one: {size}: {count} label more than the garments finished now (a scan was undone after the print). Tell the office.
sizes.overLabelled_other: {size}: {count} labels more than the garments finished now (a scan was undone after the print). Tell the office.

gate.title: Certificate check · {size}
gate.notRequired: This style needs no PPE certificate: its labels print as they are.

preview.invalid: This code cannot print as a barcode: {value}
preview.standIn: Stand-in artwork: the CE mark, the PPE pictogram and the care symbols are placeholders until the real artwork is set up. Not final.
preview.serialStandIn: The serial shown is an example: each garment gets its own when it prints.
preview.sample: Shown as a sample: the label prints with the real batch number.
preview.none: The label of this size is not on this tablet: it shows when the network is back.
preview.reading: Reading the label of this size…

printer.none: This site has no label printer. Tell the office.
printer.noneFits: No label printer here takes this label’s size. Tell the office.

held.offline: Printing needs the network: each garment label is logged by the office at once.
held.blocked: Nothing of this work order prints now.
held.refused: This size cannot print today: see the certificate check.
held.noPrinter: No label printer here takes this label.
held.nothingFinished: Nothing of this size is finished at the final operation yet.
held.scanSerial: Every garment of this size has its serial. To print one again, scan its label.
held.nothingLeft: Every finished garment has its label.

jobs.title: Print jobs
jobs.notMade: Labels that made no print job

reprint.title: Print labels again?
reprint.question_one: {count} label of {size} was printed. Why again?
reprint.question_other: {count} labels of {size} were printed. Why again?
reprint.questionAt_one: {count} label of {size} was printed at {time}. Why again?
reprint.questionAt_other: {count} labels of {size} were printed at {time}. Why again?
reprint.serialQuestion: The label of {serial} was printed. Why again? The same serial prints.
reprint.range: From 1 to {max}: never more than were printed.
reprint.logged: Every reprint is logged with its reason.

done.title: Labels of {number} printed
done.body_one: {count} label printed on this visit. Every print is logged.
done.body_other: {count} labels printed on this visit. Every print is logged.

notice.stepUp: Your PIN is needed for this.
notice.forbidden: Your role may not do this at this station.
notice.notFound: It is no longer at this site. Scan the work order again.
notice.conflict: It changed meanwhile: it was read again. Check the numbers and try again.
notice.invalid: The office did not accept it as it was sent. Check the numbers and try again.
notice.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
notice.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment, then try again.
notice.unavailable: The office did not answer. Try again in a moment.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.title: Labels cannot print at this site yet
FLOOR_NOT_READY.body: Floor work here waits for the office: the privacy steps or the floor rules are not complete. Tell the office.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.title: Work order {number} is not open for labels
WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.body: Only a released or running work order prints garment labels. Tell the office.

NO_LABEL_TEMPLATE.title: No garment label is set for {style}
NO_LABEL_TEMPLATE.body: The style’s released revision names no label. Tell quality.

NO_BATCH_NUMBER.title: Work order {number} has no batch number
NO_BATCH_NUMBER.body: Every label carries the batch number. Tell the office.

NO_FINAL_OPERATION.title: The routing of {style} has no final operation
NO_FINAL_OPERATION.body: Labels print for garments finished at the last scanned operation. Tell the office.

NOTHING_FINISHED.title: Nothing of size {size} is finished yet
NOTHING_FINISHED.body: Labels print for garments finished at the final operation.

NOTHING_TO_LABEL.title: Every finished garment of size {size} has its label
NOTHING_TO_LABEL.body: To print one again, use Reprint.

MORE_THAN_FINISHED.title: More labels than finished garments in size {size}
MORE_THAN_FINISHED.body: Labels never outnumber the garments finished. The numbers were read again: check them.

CERTIFICATE.title: No valid certificate covers size {size} of {style}

TEMPLATE_NOT_ACTIVE.title: The label layout was retired
TEMPLATE_NOT_ACTIVE.body: Labels cannot print with it. Tell the office.

LABEL_NOT_PRINTABLE.title: This label cannot print as it is
LABEL_NOT_PRINTABLE.body: Something on it is missing or does not fit. Tell quality.

NO_PRINTER.title: No label printer here takes this label
NO_PRINTER.body: Tell the office to set up a label printer for this site.

MORE_THAN_PRINTED.title: More labels again than were printed
MORE_THAN_PRINTED.body: Lower the number and try again.

SERIAL_VOID.title: This serial was cancelled
SERIAL_VOID.body: Its garment has a new serial: scan that label.

SERIAL_SHIPPED.title: This garment has already shipped
SERIAL_SHIPPED.body: Its label cannot print again here. Tell the office.
